Name: Sebastian's Frog Sanctuary (NPC Expansion)
Author: SiTheGreat1
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
This mod adds 10 events, 2 quests, some mail, some dialogue, and a few schedule changes. This includes marriage schedules, but dating/marriage is not required to enjoy this mod (though there is a bonus marriage event if you choose to do so).

If you choose to marry him and view his 14-heart events after beginning the events in this mod, the dialogue in his 14-heart events will be slightly modified to fit this mod better. You can disable this in the config.

All of this mod's content begins after you have seen Sebastian's 8-heart event. You will also need to have unlocked Trinkets to progress this mod. This mod can be added to preexisting saves.

[b]Mod Compatibilities (so far)
[/b][list]
[*][b][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿[/i][/b][i]:[/i] compatible!
[*]Other expansion mods (RSV, ES, VMV etc): should be compatible, but let me know if you find any issues.
[*][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17775]Part of a Saloon Breakfast[/url]﻿: [/i]compatible!
[*][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25841]Maggs Immersive Sebastian[/url]﻿:[/i] compatible, though some of the dialogue may override mine. This won't cause any issues with your save, it just means you might miss a few of my mod's dialogue lines.
[*]Other Seb dialogue mods ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11161]Xander's Sebastian Rework[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16840]Even More Dialogue - Sebastian 1.6[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2060]Mal's Sebastian Expansion[/url]﻿, etc): same as above, some of the dialogue may get overridden but otherwise compatible; feel free to turn off dialogue in my mod's config if you want to ensure you only see the dialogue added by the other mod (you can turn it back on any time!)
[*][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8945][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13088][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8945]Bolier's Sam and Sebastian Rival Heart Events[/url]﻿﻿: [/i]same as above, dialogue may get overridden but otherwise compatible, feel free to turn off my mod's dialogue in the config.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10483]Sambastian Romance[/url][i]:[/i] same note about dialogue and compatibility as above, BUT my mod's rain schedule for Seb will also override the rain schedule added by the Sambastian mod. You can turn off my mod's rain schedule in the config.
[*][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8945]Sebastian, Abigail, and Farmer Polyamory Events[/url]﻿[/i]: compatible!
[*][b][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34252]Star Crossed[/url]﻿[/i][/b]: compatible!
[*][b][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14212]Fourteen Heart Events For All[/url]﻿[/i][/b]: to enable compatibility, open the config, disable EditEvents, and enable PlatonicBonusEvent
[*]This mod adds a couple lines of dialogue to Sebastian and a few other characters; it's there for flavor but can be disabled in the config if you find it conflicts with one of your other mods.
[*]This mod doesn't add any new sprites/portraits, so it should be compatible with any other mods that do (DSV, Seasonal Outfits etc).
[*]This mod doesn't change any maps but it does add a couple of map strings, let me know if they cause any issues for you.
[/list][b]Crossover Content
[/b][list]
[*][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33203]Book Collecting[/url]﻿[/i]: if installed, this mod adds two more books for you to collect.
[/list][b]Events[/b][spoiler]
[list]
[*]Any time after seeing Sebastian's 8-heart event, gift him a Frog Egg. The next morning, you will receive a letter from him with a quest.
[*]The day after completing the first quest, you will receive another letter from him.
[*]Go to his room at around 2pm. You will receive another quest (you will be able to choose between two quest options).
[*]The day after completing the second quest, you will receive another letter from him.
[*]Go to the mountain at around 3pmfor an event.
[*]In the Spring season (at least a week after the last event), you'll get another letter.
[*]In the Spring season, go to the mountain on a sunny day between 8am and 6pm. After this event, schedule changes will be in effect (see the Schedules section below for details).
[*]A few days later you'll get the fifth letter.
[*]After the fifth letter, there will be one event available in each of the other seasons (Summer, Fall, and Winter). There is a small time delay between each of these events as well, so if you trigger one at the end of the season the next one will occur a few days after starting the next season. These three events can be viewed in any order.
[*]The Summer event is on the mountain on a sunny day between 8am and 5pm.
[*]The Fall event is on the mountain between 8am and 5pm.
[*]The Winter event is in the museum between 10am and 2pm.
[*]After the fifth letter, there will also be an event when you go to the resort area of Ginger Island while Sebastian is there.
[*]A week after the resort event, go to the Gourmand Frog's cave for another event.
[*]After the Gourmand Frog event, go to the resort area while Sebastian is there again for another event.
[*]After seeing all of these events, go to Sebastian's room while here's there for an event.
[*]You'll receive a letter a few days later. After this letter, Robin will occasionally sell Frog Eggs in her shop.
[*]If you choose to marry Sebastian, there is a bonus event that you can trigger after seeing all the other events and his 14-heart event while married by visiting the mountain when it's rainy and not Winter between 8pm and 11pm. This event is not required for the plot, it's just meant to be a sweet moment between the two of you :)
[/list][/spoiler]
[b]Schedules[/b][spoiler]
[list]
[/list][list]
[*]Sebastian will walk around the lake on the 23rd of each month whether unmarried or married, and has a 50% chance of also doing so on rainy days when not married.
[*]Vincent will do the same, but on the 21st of each month and 50% of rainy days.[/spoiler]
[/list][b]Config[/b][spoiler]
[list]
[/list][list]
[*]SebSched: Default enabled. When disabled, Sebastian won't follow the regular schedule added by this mod.
[*]SebRainSched: Default enabled. When disabled, Sebastian won't follow the rain schedule added by this mod.
[*]VincentSched: Default enabled. When disabled, Vincent won't follow the regular schedule added by this mod.
[*]VincentRainSched: Default enabled. When disabled, Vincent won't follow the rain schedule added by this mod.
[*]EditEvents: Default enabled. When disabled, Sebastian's vanilla 14-heart event won't be modified to match this mod.
[*]DialoguePatches: Default enabled. When disabled, dialogue added by this mod won't be applied. Does not include conversation topics.
[*]Froggy: Default enabled. When enabled alongside DialoguePatches, Sebastian will occasionally call you 'Froggy' as a pet name if you're married to him.
[*]CrossoverContent: Default enabled. When disabled, crossover content will not occur. Does not include compatibility patches.
[*]PlatonicBonusEvent: Default disabled. When enabled, you'll be able to view a platonic version of the bonus event added by this mod instead of the romantic version. This option was made to be used together with the Fourteen Heart Events For All mod, but can be used without it.[/spoiler]
[/list][b]Translations
[/b]No AI translations please. This mod is i18n-compatible! Translators, you can either send me a translation file to be included in the main mod files, or maintain your own separate mod translation. If you choose to have your own separate translation mod, please ensure it requires my mod to be downloaded (either as a dependency or as a file replacer), and let me know once it's up. Thank you!

[b]Art Replacements
[/b]No AI art please. If you'd like to make and publish your own version of any of the art I created for this mod, feel free! Just set my mod as a dependency and let me know once it's up. Thank you!

[b]Bug Reports
[/b]If you encounter any bugs or issues while playing, please post them in the Bugs tab with a link to your SMAPI log. Include a SMAPI log even if you don't see any errors in the SMAPI window. Instructions for generating a SMAPI log are here: smapi.io/log

[list]

[/list]

Downloads.Description: Added i18n, fixed the frog gift bug, added some mod compats, added books if Book Collecting is installed, made island events work if already married to Seb, and config'd the rain schedule. Please delete your old mod file and install the new one to update
